Facilities Team

passages.title: Community business profile · Document 1
passages.text:
A SMALL WORKSHOP CHANGES ITS MODEL

For years, Larch Woodworks sold handmade desks directly from its workshop. Last autumn, owner Eva Moss stopped keeping finished desks in stock and began making each one only after an order was confirmed. The change cut storage costs and allowed customers to choose dimensions, but delivery now takes four to six weeks.

Moss says the switch was prompted by rising rent, not a shortage of orders. She still displays two sample desks in a shared showroom downtown. Visitors can examine the workmanship there, while appointments at the workshop are reserved for discussing custom designs. The business has not reduced its staff; two employees who previously managed stored stock now coordinate customer measurements and installation dates.

Customers should disconnect the appliance only when instructed, since a running-temperature log may help diagnose intermittent problems.
